quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. 'The night before work' combines two time ideas.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + prepares (verb) + her lunch (object) + the night before work (time). 'The night before' refers to the evening preceding the next day at work.
quests.textToSpeak: She prepares her lunch the night before work.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. 'Because' introduces the reason. 'Faster' is comparative.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + takes the train (verb + object) + because it is faster (reason clause). 'Because + clause' explains the reason; 'faster' is the comparative form of 'fast'.
quests.textToSpeak: He takes the train because it is faster.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past passive. 'Due to' is the formal reason.
quests.explanation: Subject (The office meeting) + was cancelled (passive past tense) + due to weather (reason). 'Due to' is a formal preposition meaning 'because of', followed by a noun phrase.
quests.textToSpeak: The office meeting was cancelled due to weather.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Some useful feedback' is the object. 'Today' ends it.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + gave (past tense) + her colleague (indirect object) + some useful feedback (direct object) + today (time). 'Give feedback' is an important professional expression.
quests.textToSpeak: She gave her colleague some useful feedback today.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To his manager' is the recipient. 'Yesterday' ends it.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + sent (past tense) + the report (object) + to his manager (recipient) + yesterday (time). 'Send something to someone' follows the indirect object pattern.
quests.textToSpeak: He sent the report to his manager yesterday.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Just before the deadline' shows it was very close.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + finished (past tense) + the project (object) + just before the deadline (time). 'Just before' means at the very last moment; 'deadline' is the final date for completion.
quests.textToSpeak: They finished the project just before the deadline.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Applied for' is a phrasal verb. Location tells us where the job is.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + applied for (phrasal verb) + a job (object) + at the local hospital (place). 'Apply for a job' means to formally request to be considered for a position.
quests.textToSpeak: She applied for a job at the local hospital.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two parallel job-seeking actions joined by 'and'.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + updated (verb 1) + his resume (object 1) + and + wrote (verb 2) + a cover letter (object 2). Two past actions joined by 'and' show preparation for a goal.
quests.textToSpeak: He updated his resume and wrote a cover letter.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Three candidates' are the people. 'For the position' is the purpose.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + interviewed (past tense) + three candidates (object) + for the position (purpose) + today (time). 'Interview candidates' is standard recruitment vocabulary.
quests.textToSpeak: They interviewed three candidates for the position today.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'Before leaving home' shows the preparatory step.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + checked (past tense) + the train schedule (object) + before leaving home (time clause). 'Before + verb-ing' shows that checking was the preparatory first step.
quests.textToSpeak: She checked the train schedule before leaving home.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. A 'return ticket' covers both directions of a journey.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + bought (past tense) + a return ticket (object) + at the counter (place). A 'return ticket' covers the journey both ways; a 'single' covers one way.
quests.textToSpeak: He bought a return ticket at the counter.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past passive. 'By about twenty minutes' shows the approximate delay.
quests.explanation: Subject (The train) + was delayed (passive verb) + by about twenty minutes (amount). 'By + amount' shows the degree of delay; 'about' signals an approximation.
quests.textToSpeak: The train was delayed by about twenty minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'In photography' tells us the subject of the course.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + registered for (phrasal verb) + an online course (object) + in photography (topic). 'Register for' means to officially sign up for something.
quests.textToSpeak: She registered for an online course in photography.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two academic actions joined by 'and'.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + attended (verb 1) + every lecture (object 1) + and + took (verb 2) + detailed notes (object 2). 'Take detailed notes' is the standard academic English expression.
quests.textToSpeak: He attended every lecture and took detailed notes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'With high marks' tells us the result.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + passed (past tense) + the final exam (object) + with high marks (result). 'With high marks' means achieving a high score; 'pass an exam' means to succeed in it.
quests.textToSpeak: They passed the final exam with high marks.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'With plants and artwork' tells us what she used.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + decorated (past tense) + her apartment (object) + with plants and artwork (means). 'Decorate with' uses 'with' to introduce what was used for decoration.
quests.textToSpeak: She decorated her apartment with plants and artwork.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'A light shade of blue' describes the resulting color.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + painted (past tense) + his bedroom (object) + a light shade of blue (result). 'A shade of' describes a particular variation of a color.
quests.textToSpeak: He painted his bedroom a light shade of blue.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To create more space' explains why they moved things.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + moved (past tense) + the furniture (object) + around (manner) + to create more space (purpose). 'Around' means in various directions to change the arrangement.
quests.textToSpeak: They moved the furniture around to create more space.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. 'From home' tells us where the business operates.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + runs (verb) + a small online business (object) + from home (place). 'Run a business' is the standard expression for managing or operating a company.
quests.textToSpeak: She runs a small online business from home.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. 'Remotely' is manner; 'every day' is frequency.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + manages (verb) + his team of five (object) + remotely (manner) + every day (frequency). 'Remotely' means from a different physical location, usually from home.
quests.textToSpeak: He manages his team of five remotely every day.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To positive reviews' describes the favorable reception.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + launched (past tense) + their new product (object) + to positive reviews (result). 'To positive reviews' means the product was favorably received when released.
quests.textToSpeak: They launched their new product to positive reviews.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'At the restaurant' is the setting.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + chose (past tense) + a vegetarian option (object) + at the restaurant (place). 'Chose' is the irregular past tense of 'choose'; 'vegetarian' describes food without meat.
quests.textToSpeak: She chose a vegetarian option at the restaurant.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'After finishing' shows the sequence of events.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + ordered (past tense) + a dessert (object) + after finishing his main course (time). 'After + verb-ing' shows that the main course was finished before ordering dessert.
quests.textToSpeak: He ordered a dessert after finishing his main course.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two actions: splitting and paying equally.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + split (verb 1) + the bill (object 1) + and + each paid (verb 2) + equally (manner). 'Split the bill' means to divide the cost; 'equally' means each person paid the same amount.
quests.textToSpeak: They split the bill and each paid equally.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. 'At the local food bank' is where. 'On Saturdays' is when.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + volunteers (verb) + at the local food bank (place) + on Saturdays (time). 'Volunteer at' means to offer your time without payment at a specific organization.
quests.textToSpeak: She volunteers at the local food bank on Saturdays.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'To the charity shop' is the recipient.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + donated (past tense) + his old clothes (object) + to the charity shop (recipient). 'Donate to' means to give something for charitable purposes.
quests.textToSpeak: He donated his old clothes to the charity shop.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'For the school library' is the beneficiary.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + helped organize (verb phrase) + a fundraiser (object) + for the school library (beneficiary). 'Help + verb' (without 'to') is a common informal pattern.
quests.textToSpeak: They helped organize a fundraiser for the school library.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'After a long day' gives the context.
quests.explanation: Subject (She) + streamed (past tense) + her favorite show (object) + after a long day (time). 'Stream' as a verb means to watch video content online.
quests.textToSpeak: She streamed her favorite show after a long day.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. 'About history' is the topic. 'Last week' ends it.
quests.explanation: Subject (He) + subscribed to (phrasal verb) + a podcast (object) + about history (topic) + last week (time). 'Subscribe to' means to sign up to regularly receive content.
quests.textToSpeak: He subscribed to a podcast about history last week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Past tense. Two actions in sequence. 'Afterwards' ends it.
quests.explanation: Subject (They) + watched (verb 1) + the documentary (object) + together + and + discussed (verb 2) + it (pronoun) + afterwards (time). 'Afterwards' means after the event just described.
quests.textToSpeak: They watched the documentary together and discussed it afterwards.
